339-677-7272-8296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7272-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

855-5254-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-6719.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2103-5144-7874.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking The Immortal Weapons and exiling Ephemerate.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4681-5147-5170-6772.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3967-6972-7237.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

413-2730-5237.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Renegade Rallier trigger, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4053-4336-5256-6989.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

280-654-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-654-4572-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2486-6797--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

147-167-2034.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

1867-2206-3129-4231-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1379-1978-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

751-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Drake.
751-2440-3263.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {1}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {2}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1256-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can produce at least {2}{G}.
1256-1636.description:
Activate creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 1, this combo produces infinite mana.

2744-4186.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak's last ability triggers, allowing you to create a 1/1/ Squirrel token.
When the Squirrel token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 3 until you end the loop by declining to create a Squirrel token.

3519-3705.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Squee, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

618-3464.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.

75-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
75-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping itself.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing a -1/-1 counter from Devoted Druid, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
